name: Hiougi Mimori
source:
She is the senior priestess of the Shrine. In fact, when the Masazaku was a child living in the village, she was the sister he used to play with during the summer.

She wants Masakazu to call her "Mimo-ane" and treats her like a big sister. She is calm but sometimes forceful. Always at her own pace. She uses old fashioned words.

The tool she uses for exorcism is a "shimenawa whip.

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_miko2.htm]official site[/url]]
